column3: Keep the composer's UI SDK elements out of the startup files: Token Input and Trigger Menu load when the composer mounts, while Menu and Combobox load on their trigger's first hover, focus or click (lib/ui-sdk-lazy.ts)
column4: After #81 main's startup JS is about 252 KB, and the lane target is 255 KB or less. Command stays in the startup files because pane.tsx imports it statically
